sources.title: INDECI recomienda medidas de preparación ante precipitaciones en la costa centro y sur
sources.title_en: INDECI recommends preparedness measures for rainfall on the central and southern coast

summaries_original.es: INDECI recomienda medidas de preparación ante el aviso meteorológico N.° 450 (nivel naranja) del SENAMHI, que informa sobre precipitaciones (lluvia y/o lloviznas) de moderada a fuerte intensidad en la costa centro y sur.

stories.summary_en: INDECI, Peru's national civil defence institute, issued preparedness recommendations following SENAMHI meteorological warning No. 450 at orange level, which forecasts moderate to heavy rain and/or drizzle on the central and southern coast. The warning concerns the communication of an impending precipitation event and the measures recommended in response.
stories.title: INDECI recommends preparedness measures for rainfall on the central and southern coast

sources.title_en: SENAMHI presents climate outlooks and El Niño scenarios to strengthen Piura agriculture preparedness

summaries_original.es: El SENAMHI participó en el II Foro Regional Fenómeno El Niño y Agro Piurano, presentando perspectivas climáticas y escenarios de El Niño para fortalecer la preparación frente a eventos climáticos.

stories.summary_en: SENAMHI, Peru's national meteorological and hydrological service, took part in the second regional forum on El Niño and Piura agriculture, presenting climate outlooks and El Niño scenarios. The aim is to strengthen agricultural preparedness for climate events through prevention and mitigation actions. The item concerns forecasting and preparedness rather than a specific warning outcome.
stories.title: SENAMHI presents climate outlooks and El Niño scenarios to strengthen Piura agriculture preparedness

sources.title_en: SENAMHI and Consorcio S&F carry out technical visit to exchange information on the operation of the meteorological radar

summaries_original.es: El SENAMHI realizó una segunda visita técnica junto al Consorcio S&F, a cargo del proyecto "Solución Integral de la Quebrada Cansas", para intercambiar información sobre el funcionamiento del radar meteorológico.

stories.summary_en: SENAMHI, Peru's national meteorological and hydrological service, held a second technical visit with Consorcio S&F, the contractor for the Quebrada Cansas integral solution project, to exchange information on how the meteorological radar operates. The item concerns monitoring infrastructure supporting hazard detection, but reports no warning issued or outcome.
stories.title: SENAMHI and Consorcio S&F carry out technical visit to exchange information on the operation of the meteorological radar

actions: Sinaproc extended the prevention notice for rain and storms until 3 November
stories.outcome_justification: The item reports a warning issued and extended but does not describe its impacts or how it was received.

sources.title: Nueva alerta meteorológica en Panamá agrava la preocupación por las zonas devastadas por el terremoto - Infobae
sources.title_en: New weather alert in Panama heightens concern for areas devastated by earthquake

summaries_original.es: El Sinaproc extendió hasta el 3 de noviembre el aviso de prevención por lluvias y tormentas en gran parte de Panamá, coincidiendo con zonas afectadas por el terremoto del 9 de octubre. El Imhpa advierte sobre posibles inundaciones, crecidas repentinas de ríos, deslizamientos y ráfagas de viento.

stories.summary_en: Panama's civil protection agency Sinaproc extended until 3 November a prevention notice for rain and storms covering much of the country, including areas hit by the 9 October earthquake. The national meteorological service Imhpa warns of possible flooding, flash floods in rivers, landslides and strong gusts of wind.
stories.title: New weather alert in Panama heightens concern for areas devastated by earthquake

agencies.name: Coordinación Estatal de Protección Civil de Baja California

stories.outcome_justification: The item reports a warning and forecast of heavy rain, strong winds and cooling but gives no information on outcomes or impacts.

sources.title: Advierte Protección Civil por aumento en el pronóstico de lluvias muy fuertes y alerta por riesgo de inundaciones
sources.title_en: State Civil Protection warns of increased forecast for very heavy rains and flood risk

summaries_original.es: La Coordinación Estatal de Protección Civil de Baja California advirtió un aumento del potencial de lluvias fuertes, puntualmente muy fuertes, con vientos intensos y descenso de temperaturas hasta el domingo 1 de noviembre, con acumulados mayores a 50 mm en los siete municipios.

stories.summary_en: The Baja California State Civil Protection Coordination warned that the potential for heavy rains, locally very heavy, strong winds and falling temperatures is increasing until Sunday 1 November 2026. Accumulations above 50 mm are expected across the state's seven municipalities, raising flood risk.
stories.title: State Civil Protection warns of increased forecast for very heavy rains and flood risk

Río León basin declared in red hydrological alert
Dimar warned of strong swell and high tides on the Caribbean Coast until 1 November
stories.outcome_justification: The snippet reports warnings issued but no outcomes, impacts or responses are described.

sources.title: ¡Alerta en el Golfo de Urabá! Ideam advierte inundaciones y fuerte oleaje en la Costa Caribe
sources.title_en: Alert in the Gulf of Urabá! Ideam warns of floods and strong swell on the Caribbean Coast

summaries_original.es: El Ideam emitió una alerta hidrológica preventiva para el Golfo de Urabá y otras cuencas de Antioquia por probabilidad de inundaciones y desbordamientos, y la cuenca del río León fue declarada en alerta roja hidrológica. La Dimar advierte fuerte oleaje en la Costa Caribe y mareas altas hasta el 1 de noviembre.

stories.summary_en: Colombia's meteorological service Ideam issued a preventive hydrological alert for the Gulf of Urabá and other Antioquia basins over the probability of flooding and overflows, and declared the León river basin in red hydrological alert. The maritime agency Dimar warned of strong swell and high tides on the Caribbean Coast until 1 November.
stories.title: Alert in the Gulf of Urabá! Ideam warns of floods and strong swell on the Caribbean Coast

sources.title: Lluvias en el norte del Perú hoy EN VIVO: Piura, Tumbes y Lambayeque en alerta por precipitaciones
sources.title_en: Rain in northern Peru LIVE: Piura, Tumbes and Lambayeque on alert for rainfall

summaries_original.es: Senamhi activó una nueva alerta roja por precipitaciones de fuerte a extrema intensidad en Tumbes y Piura, y el COEN-Indeci informó que EMAPE culminó la limpieza tras la inundación del 29/10 en Villa María del Triunfo.

stories.summary_en: Senamhi activated a new red alert for strong to extreme rainfall in the Peruvian regions of Tumbes and Piura, while Lambayeque is also listed on alert. COEN-Indeci reported that EMAPE finished cleanup after a flood on 29 October in Villa María del Triunfo.
stories.title: Rain in northern Peru LIVE: Piura, Tumbes and Lambayeque on alert for rainfall

sources.title: How Asia and the Pacific can take the heat off tourism
sources.title_en: How Asia and the Pacific can take the heat off tourism

stories.summary_en: The article argues that the tourism sector in Asia and the Pacific can lead efforts to address extreme heat through affordable measures, early warning systems, worker protection and climate-resilient planning. It presents the H.E.A.T. Framework as a practical approach. The early warning aspect is mentioned as one of several recommended measures.
